turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Good morning. How can I help?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Good morning. I'm in room 214, in a single room. My name's Sam.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Hello, Sam. What can I do for you?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: A friend is joining me tomorrow for my last two nights. Could we change to a room for two people?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I'm afraid our twin rooms are full tomorrow. One is free from the day after tomorrow, for eighty-five dollars a night.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That doesn't work, because he arrives tomorrow. Is there anything else?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: We have a family room for both nights at a hundred and ten a night. Or he could have a second single room for sixty.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Two singles would be a hundred and twenty a night, so the family room is cheaper. We'll take the family room, please.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Good choice. You can move tomorrow at twelve, and we can keep your bags here in the morning.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Perfect. So, the family room for the last two nights, a hundred and ten a night, and we move at twelve.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Exactly. I've changed it for you.
